stories.title: CISA Warns of GitLab Path Traversal Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA has added a critical GitLab vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-85706, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, warning that attackers are actively exploiting the flaw.

stories.title: Users in Houthi-Held Yemen Tried to Develop Advanced Weapons With AI, Anthropic Says
stories.description: Anthropic said the users did not succeed in “fielding an operational device” but did carry out a failed test of a guided rocket.

stories.title: Phishing Research Challenges Conventional Security Awareness Testing
stories.description: Analysis of 2.47 million simulated attacks shows why organizations should measure credential leaks and reporting, not just clicks.

stories.title: GitLab CVSS 10 File-Read Flaw Draws In-the-Wild Probes After Disclosure
stories.description: GitLab patched CVE-2026-85706, a CVSS 10 path traversal flaw enabling unauthenticated file reads, as in-the-wild probes began.

stories.title: Anthropic Says Seven China-Based AI Labs Ran Industrial-Scale Claude Distillation Attacks
stories.description: Anthropic says China-based AI labs ran illicit Claude distillation campaigns using proxy networks, fake accounts, and harvested user exchanges.

stories.title: GitLab Vulnerability Exploited One Day After Disclosure
stories.description: The critical-severity path traversal flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files from the GitLab server.

stories.title: Russia-Aligned Hackers Use GuardBreaker Prompt Injection to Disrupt AI Malware Analysis
stories.description: GuardBreaker hides malicious prompts in script comments to trick AI code scanners into bypassing safety checks and deploying malware.

stories.title: Claude Used to Automate Exploitation and Data Theft Across Multiple Victims
stories.description: Anthropic says threat actors used Claude in autonomous cyber operations, including reconnaissance, exploitation, and data theft.

stories.title: In Other News: InjectEave Attack, SIM Swapper Sentenced, Glasswing Findings Review
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Invisible Unicode slips past phishing filters, US puts $10 million bounty on Iranian cyber official, military ties of Chinese hacking group QTFY.

stories.title: New KATARU IoT Malware Packs Linux Privilege Escalation Exploits and Mirai-Style DDoS Attacks
stories.description: KATARU IoT malware exploits weak Telnet passwords to turn devices into persistent DDoS bots, targeting poorly secured systems.

stories.title: Russian State-Sponsored Hackers Use Claude to Rebuild Malware After Detection
stories.description: Anthropic disrupted GTG-20006, a Russian state-sponsored actor that used Claude to rebuild malware after security products detected it.
